decisions.reason: Although it serves a maritime customer group the firm already knows, submarine interior lighting is more distant from its core knowledge base, so absorptive capacity for improving and scaling it is weaker and management is more likely to reallocate resources elsewhere.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's established industrial lighting capabilities, and the 2019 LED replacement-kit update shows that it can learn from early market experience and refine the line.
A relaunched and previously popular task light is close to the firm's existing expertise, so the firm can readily absorb feedback and sustain it as part of its professional lighting offer.

A pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core office and commercial lighting domain, where its engineering, service and energy-efficiency know-how make continued improvement and commercialization straightforward.

This premium pendant luminaire line is closely related to the firm's established business and benefits from its strong in-house R&D and product-family capabilities, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
